description: This file defines a View class for a Todo application, handling DOM manipulation and event binding for task display, editing, filtering, and completion toggling.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class that manages the user interface for a Todo app, including rendering tasks, filters, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the View with a template and caches DOM elements.

methods.description: Updates the DOM based on the specified command and parameters.
